diagnosis: The application case must expose the constructors of `fn` and `e`; otherwise `extractOldExprVars` remains stuck on its nested pattern match. In the old-predicate branch, normalization forces a free-variable argument, so unfolding extraction reduces membership to the singleton variable case.

by

  induction Hnorm
  case app fn e m Hnfn Hne Hwf ihfn ihe =>

      intro a Hin
      unfold extractOldExprVars at Hin
      simpa [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] using Hin
    · intro a Hin
      cases fn <;> cases e <;>
        simp_all [extractOldExprVars,
          Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars,
          List.Subset] <;>
        grind
  all_goals
